clues.text: This wooden roller coaster stands 64 feet tall, reaches a top speed of 41 mph, and features zero inversions.
Manufactured by Gravitykraft Corporation, this thrill ride debuted in 2015.
This ride was installed at a 10-acre family amusement park located in Seguin, Texas.
This ride navigated through and around various buildings before reaching a signature element known as the "Grand Spike", which sent riders up an 87-degree incline.
This coaster derived its name from an 1884 railway regarded as the very first true roller coaster in the United States.

evidence.quote: ZDT's Amusement Park was a 10-acre (4.0 ha) family amusement park located in Seguin, Texas.
It navigated through and around various buildings and structures in the park before reaching a culminating element called the "Grand Spike", which sent riders up an 87-degree incline.
Switchback was the first and only wooden shuttle coaster of its kind, and derived its name from the 1884 Switchback Railway, the first true roller coaster in United States.
